description: Classic Google Analytics for Android — DISTINCT from firebase-analytics (the modern GA4/App+Web SDK, com.google.firebase.analytics). This entry covers Universal Analytics on Play Services (com.google.android.gms.analytics: GoogleAnalytics singleton + Tracker, artifact com.google.android.gms:play-services-analytics / -impl) and the very old v1 SDK (com.google.android.apps.analytics.GoogleAnalyticsTracker). Only fire-and-forget void hit calls are stubbed: Tracker.send/setScreenName and the enable* collection toggles, plus GoogleAnalytics session/dispatch calls. CRITICAL protections: GoogleAnalytics.getInstance (singleton the app dereferences) and Tracker.newTracker (returns the Tracker the app holds and calls send() on) are NOT stubbed — null-returning them would NPE the app. Verified against play-services-analytics-impl 18.2.0 (real javap signatures) and the play-services-analytics AAR manifest; the legacy com.google.android.apps.analytics.* class/methods are from the historical public GA v1 API (not locally decoded or AAR-verified).

methods.name: send
methods.note: Core hit sender (screenviews/events/timings/transactions); void — the single most important stub for this SDK

methods.name: setScreenName
methods.note: Screen-view name for the next hit; void

methods.name: enableAdvertisingIdCollection
methods.note: Turns on IDFA/advertising-id + IDFV collection; void — neutralizing leaves collection off

methods.name: dispatch
methods.note: Legacy v1 manual dispatch; returns boolean (whether a dispatch was started)

manifest_components.note: Analytics local broadcast receiver (declared in the play-services-analytics AAR manifest)
INSTALL_REFERRER campaign-attribution receiver (present in older integrations)
Campaign-attribution service paired with CampaignTrackingReceiver (older integrations)

protected_patterns.reason: GoogleAnalytics.getInstance(Context) returns the singleton the app immediately dereferences (newTracker/reportActivityStart/...); null would NPE

GoogleAnalytics.newTracker(int|String) returns the Tracker the app stores and calls send()/setScreenName() on; null-returning it would NPE every subsequent tracker call. Traffic is cut at Tracker.send instead
GoogleAnalytics.getLogger() returns a Logger object; leave it non-null to avoid NPEs in callers
Privacy opt-out switch (GoogleAnalytics.setAppOptOut(true) disables all collection). Leave it working; it can only reduce collection
